title: Chapter 181 Cockroaches And Destroyers
content:
Chapter 181 Cockroaches And Destroyers

"The range of the cannon is the range of truth. This makes a lot of sense. The Zerg is now lacking a type of soldier with super long range and super strong attack power!"

"Like the tanks of the interstellar human race and the golden beetles of the interstellar Protoss, these two types of soldiers with super long range and super strong attack power can be produced by upgrading the main base to the second form!"

"The Zerg can only produce air guards with this ability when the mother nest is upgraded to the third form. Now the mother nest wants to quickly upgrade three more Star level, very unrealistic!"

"We can only try to solve this problem ourselves!"

"Queen of Zerg, your research is the hope. We must speed up the progress and strive to finalize it as soon as possible. Even if the consumption is greater and there are more shortcomings, it is acceptable. We only need to hit farther and harder!"

Today, Wu Qing witnessed the range and power of the Goblin siege weapons on the battlefield of the Naga territory, saw the strategic ultra-long-range attack capability of the three-star flame demon, and saw the underground ratman archers who could almost tie with the Zerg hydralisk in the underground world.

He felt that the Zerg's firepower was not strong enough and the range was not far enough. The original advantages were gone and they urgently needed to be changed.

The mother nest evolved into the beast cave form, and the Zerg biotechnology was further unlocked, allowing the Queen of Zerg to have more gene samples collected by the Zerg.

These gene samples collected by the Zerg are all gene samples with certain value that have been preserved after a long period of research. The Zerg has recorded the editing, combination and other test data of these gene samples in detail.

This greatly facilitates the research of the Queen of Worms. As long as Wu Qing puts forward a demand, it can find genes that meet the requirements in these gene samples with detailed test data, which will save a lot of research time.

Some of these research data are research results that can be used directly, some are semi-finished products that need to be further optimized and improved, and some are just some initial research data.

The Queen of Worms showed Wu Qing a lot of research results that can be used directly, but the results are not ideal, almost all of them are things that are not used for the time being.

On the contrary, in the research data that needs to be further optimized and improved, Wu Qing found some research projects that may be helpful to the current Zerg.

Wu Qing was inspired by the strange races and creatures in this world, and had a lot of ideas, which were provided to the Queen of Worms, so that the Queen of Worms could conduct in-depth research based on these useful data.

Today, the transport host just sent back the gene samples of the three arms of the demon tribe to the Zerg territory. The Queen of Worms has conducted preliminary detection and analysis and found that the genes of the demon tribe are highly editable and adaptable, and are a very valuable type of gene samples.

This is of great help to an important research being conducted by the Queen. If everything goes well, the Zerg will soon have some powerful main combat arms.

The Queen is particularly capable of multitasking. While being responsible for all matters of the Zerg territory and the Great Xia Territory, she is also responsible for the specific command and battlefield information recording of the two wars. In the Zerg territory, she is also conducting several important studies.

One of the studies is to optimize and improve a new arm that the Zerg originally planned to add. This arm did not appear in the game that Wu Qing knew.

The Zerg wants to use the Zerg gene as a basic template, and integrate the genetic characteristics of an alien zerg with super self-healing ability and the ability to secrete super corrosive mucus, to give birth to an all-round powerful arm with super self-healing ability, long-range super corrosive attacks, strong defense ability, and strong melee ability.

The Zerg's research on this new arm is nearing completion, and I don't know why this arm was not finalized in the end.

Wu Qing is a little confused now. Is the Zerg in his hand a fiction created by the system based on the game, or does it really exist somewhere? When he saw the research data of the Zerg, he felt very historical and real.

The research of this new type of soldiers is mainly aimed at the original combat environment of the Zerg. When it is brought to this world, some places need to be adjusted. The Queen of Zerg has not found a suitable adjustment direction.

Now there is an excellent gene sample of the demon race. After the Queen of Zerg tested it, the demon race gene is very compatible with this new type of soldiers. It can comprehensively consider the ability characteristics and resource consumption to finalize one or two new types of soldiers.

The efficiency of the Zerg is very high. When Wu Qing urged him to lower the requirements, the Queen of Zerg immediately gave several options for Wu Qing to choose.

The main arms of the Zerg cannot be too many or too chaotic. The most taboo on the battlefield is that the arms are like a pot of hodgepodge!

The main arms of the Zerg should at least have a clear battlefield positioning and be able to stand alone.

It is best to form a series of its own, like the evolution of Hydralisk to Stealth Spider, the evolution of Wyvern to Air Guardian and Devourer, which can evolve from primary form to advanced form.

Wu Qing followed this principle and selected one from the finalized plans of several new arms provided by the Queen.

This plan is a combination of the new arms originally under development by the Zerg and the genes of the Demon Clan in this world, taking the advantages and making up for the disadvantages, and finally finalizing a series of two arms.

One arm makes up for the lack of area killing arms in the Zerg's medium and close combat, and the other arm satisfies Wu Qing's pursuit of ultra-long range and super strong attack arms.

These two arms were originally codenamed Cockroach and Destroyer in the Zerg's research, and Wu Qing used these two very vivid names.

The basic characteristics of the two arms are super self-healing and strong defense. The main attack method is long-range attack, and close combat can also be carried out.

In terms of attack characteristics, it inherits the close combat ability of the Zerg, and combines the super corrosiveness of the Zerg and the fire ability of the demon.

Hatching a cockroach requires a larva and 75 energy and 25 gas, which is the same as the consumption of the Zerg Hydralisk.

Evolving a cockroach to a destroyer requires 25 energy and 75 gas.

Wu Qing asked the Queen to hatch 20 cockroaches nearby in the underground base of the Zerg territory, and evolved 10 of them into destroyers and sent them to the battlefield of the underground world for actual combat testing.

When the 20 cockroaches first appeared in this world, Wu Qing saw what they looked like through the nearby host.

Cockroaches look like beetles covered with hard shells, with spikes on the back of the shells, and a pair of knife arms like puppies on the back, which can be used for close combat.

Their size is comparable to that of hydralisks, with a mouth full of sharp teeth and a ferocious appearance.

10 cockroaches pupated and evolved on the spot. The pupae kept wriggling and growing. Not long after, the destroyers that Wu Qing was looking forward to more came out of the pupae.

The destroyers are giant cockroaches, which look like behemoths larger than three cockroaches. The blade arms on their backs disappeared, replaced by a huge jet cavity.

The 10 cockroaches and 10 destroyers all have strong and powerful limbs of the Zerg, and they move very fast. When the destroyers came out of the pupae, they ran to the battlefield of the underground world together.

The hatching place of cockroaches and destroyers is the mother nest of the original cave base, which is very close to the underground world. It didn't take much time for them to pass through the barrier of the underground world and enter the battlefield of the underground world.

Cockroaches have integrated the genes of the demons. Their main attack method is to spray a mixture of super corrosive mucus and high-temperature flames, which is very unique. Even when facing enemies like the demons who have strong flame resistance, their super corrosive characteristics can easily kill the enemies.

The corrosive mucus of cockroaches is mixed with the biodegradable liquid of the Zerg, but it is no longer a simple biodegradable liquid. It is more corrosive and more resistant to high temperatures.

The flames they spew are the hellfire spewed by the demon dog demons.

The characteristics of the long-range attack of the destroyer are similar to those of the cockroach, with only an additional explosion characteristic.

10 cockroaches followed the Zerg puppies who came to reinforce the front line and entered the front line of the battle. Their long-range attacks are not pure Zerg biodegradable liquid, and they will also cause damage to the Zerg, so they cannot spray and attack the Zerg puppies.

The Zerg puppies gave them some space, which made the underground rat archers in the distance notice them, and several armor-piercing heavy arrows shot over.

These arrows basically shot on the protruding spikes on the back of the cockroach carapace and fell directly. Only one armor-piercing heavy arrow was lucky enough to penetrate the carapace and cause a little damage to the cockroach.

The cockroach that was injured by the armor-piercing heavy arrow hooked the heavy arrow with the knife arm on its back. The wounds on its body healed quickly, and the pierced shells were repaired at a speed visible to the naked eye.

The Zerg puppy in front of the cockroach finally fell under the continuous attack of the ghouls, and the corpse disappeared in light. The cockroaches walked to the front line. In front of them were densely packed ghouls, and the claws of the ghouls in front grabbed the cockroaches.

"Huh!"

An extremely hot and sticky flame spurted out of the cockroach's mouth, and a large area of ghouls in front were instantly ignited. The high-temperature flame and powerful corrosive mucus caused them great damage!

The vitality of the ghouls was very tenacious. Although they could no longer attack, they did not die for a while.

Another cockroach next to it added another mouthful of flame, and the ghouls that were close to it suffered the greatest damage from the two attacks, and all turned into light and disappeared!

All 10 cockroaches crowded to the front and began to spray flames at the rushing ghouls. The ghouls fell down in groups and disappeared in light due to this new type of attack.

10 cockroaches continuously sprayed and attacked in a small area, and the ghouls could not rush up all of a sudden. This situation was somewhat similar to the attack of the dog demons against the Zerg puppies. The dog demons with sufficient flames gathered together, and the Zerg puppies rushed forward to die.
